causalChain: Signal: Three pods owned by `ReplicaSet/web-cluster-56c7c6856b` are Pending with `PodScheduled=False`.
Why? The scheduler reports `0/2 nodes are available: 2 Insufficient memory`, and preemption reports no victims for each pod.
Why? Each pending pod requests `2Gi` memory, so three additional replicas require `6Gi` of requested memory beyond the 11 already scheduled replicas on the only two selector-matching nodes.
Why? `Deployment/web-cluster` was configured/scaled to `14` replicas while its pod template reserves `2Gi` memory per replica and selects the limited two-node pool.

Root cause: The `Deployment/web-cluster` workload configuration creates more 2Gi memory reservations than the cluster’s schedulable capacity can accommodate; modify the Deployment’s replica/resource configuration or provision capacity.

Node remediation would add broad capacity rather than correct the specific workload configuration.

Three replicas are affected by one Deployment revision, so a targeted workload change is more proportional than modifying healthy nodes or unrelated workloads.
